subject: Arcadia Hosted→Dedicated: preflight smoke, cache validation & rollback cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia Hosted→Dedicated: preflight smoke, cache validation & rollback cadence

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the sync this week. Per our run-through I sketched a short preflight plan so we can validate sizing and have a clear swap/rollback cadence for the Dedicated cutover. Can you confirm the peak request windows below and whether we can run a short prefix/KV snapshot ahead of the swap?

Quick summary (asks):
- Confirm peak sustained qps and 99th latency SLA during business hours (provide last 7 days if possible).
- Token distribution: percentage of short (<32 tokens) vs long (>512 tokens) requests.
- Can your team snapshot the live KV cache or provide a replay trace for a 2‑hour peak window?
- Accept/rollback criteria: we propose 10% token cost delta + 95th p99 latency within 20% of hosted baseline to accept.

Planned windows (proposal):
- Preflight stress / KV validation: Tue 2028-07-03 22:00–23:30 UTC (non-prod mirror)
- Staged swap (warm swap + smoke): Wed 2028-07-04 02:00–04:00 UTC (1h smoke, 1h validation)
- Roll-forward window: Wed 2028-07-04 04:00–08:00 UTC (monitor + scale if needed)
- Hard rollback cut: Wed 2028-07-04 08:00 UTC if acceptance gates fail

Attachments: arcadia_capacity_export.csv (traffic breakdown + token histograms).

If that schedule looks OK I’ll book the engineering runbooks and loop in Marissa for the post-cutover billing/commit alignment.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

--
Jordan Blake

- Peak: our production peak is roughly 450 qps sustained (15:00–17:00 ET) with p99 ~ 420ms. Weekend traffic is ~30% lower. I attached a short export to the Ops thread.
- Token distro: ~63% short (<64), 25% mid (64–256), 12% long (>256).
- KV snapshot: our infra team can produce a serialized prefix/KV dump but security requires an air-gapped transfer. If replay traces are easier, we can share a 2‑hour gzipped trace (redacted) by EOD Monday.
- Windows: Wed 2028-07-04 is tight for us — the Ops SLA team is available in the proposed time but prefers the swap start at 03:00 UTC instead of 02:00.

One operational ask: can you confirm how the Dedicated runtime will handle prefix cache population for warm swap? We want to avoid cold-start token blowups.

Lena Ortiz
VP, Infrastructure — Arcadia Health
lena@arcadiahealth.com

Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Hosted→Dedicated: preflight smoke, cache validation & rollback cadence

Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the traffic numbers, that helps a lot. Two quick answers, and an updated runbook excerpt below.

1) Prefix cache population: Redwood Dedicated supports a two-stage warm population:
   - Seed stage: we replay your 2‑hour trace to populate the KV/prefix cache on the Dedicated pool prior to swap (no traffic routed).
   - Live funnel stage: during the 1h smoke we route a small fraction (5–10%) of live traffic to the pool to validate steady-state hit rates.

2) Start time: 03:00 UTC start for staged swap is fine — I updated the timeline.

Runbook excerpt (stages and acceptance gates):
- T-6h: confirm infra tickets, upload KV dump to secure transfer (if using dump), share replay trace link.
- T-1h: dry-run stress (non-prod mirror) with the expected token histogram; validate memory/KV sizing.
- Swap start (03:00 UTC): enable warm routing to Dedicated; seed cache from replay if available.
- Smoke window (03:00–04:00 UTC): route 5–10% production, monitor hit-rate, p95/p99, OOMs. Acceptance gate: p99 <= 1.2x hosted baseline AND error rate < 0.5% AND KV hit-rate >= 60%.
- Validation (04:00–06:00 UTC): scale up to full routing, run synthetic load for 30m at peak qps; check cost per token variance <= 10%.
- Roll-forward: if validation passes, continue monitoring and hand to Arcadia for ownership.
- Rollback: if acceptance fails, automatic traffic reroute to hosted, and Dedicated pool is quarantined for post-mortem. Hard rollback at 08:00 UTC if unresolved.

I attached the preflight-checklist.pdf and a short capacity CSV we used as a baseline. Marissa — can you confirm billing alignment and whether Arcadia needs a staged commit increase for the first 30 days?

Jordan

Subject: Action items: Arcadia preflight validation & stress schedule (internal)

Team —

Following the external thread with Arcadia: they agree to a 03:00 UTC swap start on Wed 2028-07-04 and can provide replay traces by EOD Mon. Action items below: 

1) Karthik: schedule the non-prod stress run Tue 2028-07-03 22:00–23:30 UTC. Target config: N=8 A100-80GB, batcher profile "steady-low-latency", kv-cache limit 280GB. Please collect OOM, p95/p99 and token-cost deltas.
2) Marissa: confirm the short-term commit uplift and write the pricing note for the first 30 days (we should protect against token overrun during warm population).
3) Neha: prepare the post-mortem template and ensure tracing hooks are on the Dedicated pool. Set alerting for error rate >0.5% and p99 > 1.2x baseline.

Attachments for the run: stress-run-logs.tar.gz (will be uploaded to secure drive after the dry-run), preflight-checklist.pdf.

We will run the dry-run metrics against Arcadia's provided trace and share the acceptance dashboard by 06:00 UTC Wed. If anything blocks, escalate to me immediately.

Jordan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
